label: Vegetation greenness
long_name: Annual mean Normalized Difference Vegetation Index
source: NASA MODIS Terra MOD13C1 v6.1, 16-day 0.05° NDVI, aggregated to 0.5°
citation: Didan, K. (2021). MODIS/Terra Vegetation Indices 16-Day L3 Global 0.05Deg CMG V061. NASA EOSDIS LP DAAC. doi:10.5067/MODIS/MOD13C1.061
method: Mann-Kendall with bias-corrected AR(1) variance correction (Yue & Wang 2004; quadratic detrending), Theil-Sen slope, Benjamini-Hochberg FDR

significance.scale: Colour range set by Africa's confirmed trends (90th percentile); stronger changes elsewhere show at full colour.
